independent_oracle.boundary: The external packet is an oracle input, not authorization or automatically trusted repository truth.

cases.requirement: A terminal candidate releases its portfolio slot.
cases.invariant: Only non-terminal candidates occupy current selection slots.
cases.fault_injection: Count terminal candidates against max_selected_per_cycle and assert the fourth live candidate is missing.

cases.requirement: A completed prerequisite unlocks a dependent without reselection.
cases.invariant: Dependencies read append-only outcomes, not current portfolio membership.
cases.fault_injection: Resolve dependencies only from currently selected candidates.

cases.requirement: Current policy changes cannot rewrite frozen calibration.
cases.invariant: Calibration binds an immutable candidate digest and frozen prediction.
cases.fault_injection: Re-read priors or likelihoods from the mutable current policy.

cases.invariant: Source independence must resolve to a real digest-bound prior-art review.
cases.fault_injection: Accept an arbitrary nonempty source_review_id string.

cases.requirement: A prose-only mechanism packet cannot clear the mechanism gate.
cases.invariant: Presence and fluency are not evidence of an exact map or recovery contract.
cases.fault_injection: Treat a nonempty description field as an exact mechanism.

cases.requirement: The broad GLV route remains open when its exact child claim closes.
cases.invariant: Child-claim disposition never propagates implicitly to its parent route.
cases.fault_injection: Derive route closure from any bounded-negative child.

cases.requirement: Structural truth updates do not enter Brier calibration.
cases.invariant: Only native preregistered predictive outcomes contribute to calibration.
cases.fault_injection: Add structural confirmations as perfect zero-loss Brier observations.

cases.requirement: The portfolio optimizer beats a coupled greedy counterexample.
cases.invariant: Dependencies and shared budgets require exhaustive portfolio comparison at current scale.
cases.fault_injection: Select candidates independently by EIG-to-cost ratio.

cases.requirement: Eight historical event files and the reviewed root remain immutable.
cases.invariant: Both canonical scientific content and exact raw bytes are pinned.
cases.fault_injection: Reformat or migrate all event files and silently rebaseline the root.

cases.requirement: A stale branch-only source_commit is rejected after squash merge.
cases.invariant: Scientific provenance is reproducible from protected main or an immutable evidence ref.
cases.fault_injection: Use git cat-file object existence as the provenance test.

cases.requirement: A proposal plus five reviews creates only a non-authorized draft.
cases.invariant: Quality clearance and owner authorization are separate axes.
cases.fault_injection: Set authorized when all review verdicts pass.

cases.requirement: Self-review and shared model, session, or context fail independence.
cases.invariant: Independence is derived from provenance non-collision.
cases.fault_injection: Trust the declared_independent label without provenance checks.

cases.requirement: Proposal mutation invalidates old review digests.
cases.invariant: Every review is bound to the exact immutable proposal digest.
cases.fault_injection: Rebind existing reviews to the proposal currently on disk.

cases.requirement: Semantic reencoding of the closed GLV cube quotient is blocked even with a different lexical fingerprint.
cases.invariant: Adversarial mechanism review dominates lexical novelty.
cases.fault_injection: Accept a cubic-residue-class restatement because its words and fingerprint differ.

cases.requirement: A canonical claim mutation updates seeds or breaks the generated fixpoint.
cases.invariant: Seeds bind the generated claim-state digest without a second hand-maintained copy.
cases.fault_injection: Generate seed identity without the canonical claim-state digest.

cases.requirement: A semantic contradiction between decision substrate and attack registry fails.
cases.invariant: Faithful Petit, Weil descent, and toy P4 remain distinct canonical assertions.
cases.fault_injection: Restore the claim that faithful prime-field Petit requires Weil descent.

cases.requirement: More than twelve generated seeds create an explicit coverage artifact.
cases.invariant: Bounded generation never silently truncates or fails opaquely.
cases.fault_injection: Return seeds[:12] without recording the omitted identities.

cases.requirement: More than three cleared candidates enter a real portfolio comparison.
cases.invariant: The selection cap does not rewrite quality clearance; unselected candidates are deferred by digest.
cases.fault_injection: Reject or silently discard candidates beyond the first three.

cases.requirement: No test path can open route promotion or exact-target authorization.
cases.invariant: Owner authorization cannot bypass scientific or exact-target gates, and engine output never promotes routes.
cases.fault_injection: Provide an approved owner decision for an exact secp256k1 candidate and derive promotion from supported.
